name: debug-pro
description: A language-agnostic 7-step debugging protocol (reproduce -> locate the layer -> minimize -> hypothesize -> verify -> fix -> regress) shipped with a zero-dependency, offline toolchain that turns "I reproduced it" into checkable evidence. `triage` extracts exception type, last stack frame (file:line:function), exit code, HTTP or business status, timestamps, paths and ports from raw logs and writes a triage card plus a machine-readable facts file. `envsnap` produces a paste-ready environment block (OS, interpreter, cwd, git revision) with every variable whose key contains KEY/TOKEN/SECRET/PASS/CRED/AUTH/COOKIE forcibly redacted, ending the "works on my machine" loop. `reprocheck` grades whether a reproduction report carries the five minimum elements (version/environment, command or operations, input, expected vs actual, evidence) and names exactly which ones are missing. The package also includes a 10-case golden set with a runner anyone can re-execute (10/10 PASS locally), a real error-log demo covering both the correct path and the missing-element path, a layered symptom lookup table, a 5-item pre-delivery self-check, and per-blocker degradation rules. Generic methodology tool - not a medical device or medical software, with no clinical or efficacy claims; see the disclaimer bundled in the package. Triggers: debug, bug, error, exception, reproduce, root cause, minimal reproduction, regression, git bisect.
